meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Rechecked native model tool declarations and the owner navigation after the provider changes. Campaign booking receipt storage and gateway mutations remain beyond the existing read-only PHP agent capability boundary.

auth.review_note: Reviewed valid and invalid owner sign-in, flash and regenerated cookie ordering, protected campaign controls and existing customer flow. The owner notice uses the same authenticated request and one durable attempt.

commerce.review_note: Verified the reusable Razorpay identity and capture checks still feed the existing order writer for product purchases. Campaign payments write their own receipt.

content.review_note: Reviewed the final reconciled campaign editor, form, receipt, download, and booking paths. Current source retains exact publication evidence, approved money handling, scoped timestamp normalization, and matching operator help.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed canonical schema, database transaction and private download docs against the final app path. Pure PHP owns payment evidence and the new separate booking collection, and the existing record and private file boundaries remain intact.

google-tags.review_note: Rechecked the current Site analytics, Google reporting and integration routes inherited from the merged base. Campaign booking changes add no tag or reporting behavior.

http-errors.review_note: Checked the booking-specific private error responses and the main response guard. Provider and database details stay out of browser errors.

interface.review_note: Reviewed the independent amount toggle, disabled preview, keyboard booking review, and private pending and captured cards against Design and the browser fixtures.

mail.review_note: Reviewed the owner session release and supported SAPI response completion alongside existing notice queue behavior. Campaign enquiries still create only Contacts and Inbox rows.

mcp-clients.review_note: Reviewed local CLI and remote client guidance. Adding the isolated public search fixture to the CI command keeps existing client setup and capability contracts intact.

media.review_note: Checked retained campaign file descriptors and protected streaming against Media Library behavior. Booking authorization is scoped to the frozen private manifest.

operator-help.review_note: Reviewed the reconciled Pages and Email help against authorized owner login and campaign preparation. Booking previews and settings stay behind the existing role and session.

public-mcp.review_note: Checked registry additions and private booking collection ownership against the public MCP allowlist and its generated map.

remote-commerce.review_note: Reviewed the shared Razorpay link validator and signed callback routing against the existing commerce tests. Campaign records carry independent frozen booking and capture evidence and preserve the established cart and order boundary.

sales-channels.review_note: Compared the CLI skill change with the Google sales-channel test and API requirements. The extra fixture covers local storefront search parity and calls no vendor service.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed the new required local storefront search step and its failure propagation against branch checks, the guide, and the latest campaign validation workflows.
